hook: C++26 is finished, for the second time

beats.say: C++26 was first completed in March, but its international approval ballot did not pass unanimously, mostly over concerns about contracts.
At a six-day meeting in Búzios, Brazil, with about 220 attendees from 27 nations, the committee extended contracts, explained its decisions, and finished the technical work again.
The updated standard now heads to a second ballot, and the committee also adopted labeled break and continue, and views slice, for C++29.
